title: Terminal run result
description: What one run ended as, written once when the orchestration reaches its terminal state. The terminal decision belongs to n8n and is reported here; every other field is derived from the run's own recorded attempts and diagnoses, so a metrics module reads this file instead of reconstructing the workflow's state from events, absent artifacts and routing rules.

status.description: Terminal status decided by the orchestration.

outcome_code.description: Why the run ended, without the qualifier: the part of terminal_state before ':'.

terminal_reason.description: Qualifier that stopped the run there (REFINEMENT_LIMIT_REACHED, SEMANTIC_FEEDBACK_DISABLED, ...); null when the outcome carried none.

terminal_state.description: The reason string exactly as the orchestration reported it.

syntax_status.description: Status of the run's latest syntax-validation attempt; not_run when the stage never ran.

semantic_status.description: Status of the run's latest execution attempt.

diagnosis.description: Aggregate over every diagnosis this run recorded, derived from the persisted records. Conservative: one AMBIGUOUS verdict, or one of each defect kind, aggregates to AMBIGUOUS. Null when the run recorded no diagnosis.

diagnosis_records.description: How many diagnosis records the run persisted. One underlying defect can produce several, one per affected test case; clustering them is evaluation's job, not this file's.

diagnosis_classifications.description: Every recorded verdict, in attempt order, so agreement between them stays measurable.

stages.description: Latest recorded attempt per contract stage id.
